title: Food Security Card / Ration Card (Telangana)
department: Civil Supplies Department, Government of Telangana
text: The Food Security Card (ration card) entitles eligible households in Telangana to subsidised rice and other commodities through fair price shops. New card applications and member additions are submitted at MeeSeva centres. Required documents: Aadhaar cards of all family members, address proof such as electricity bill or rental agreement, existing ration card if any for corrections, and passport-size photographs. The applicant must provide the head of family details and link Aadhaar numbers of all members. After verification by the Civil Supplies staff, the card is issued and can be used at the allotted fair price shop from the following month. Corrections to name, address, or members follow the same MeeSeva application route with supporting proof.
